428361297.body: a hotfix for alpha 5. if mihawkos showed every payload as missing even though they were loaded, or games could not start with no access to data , this fixes it. everything else is the same as alpha 5 what s fixed mihawkos gets its access to data even when dev.conf is missing or points somewhere unreachable. its access helper used to quit at once when it could not reach its log server set in data homebrew dev.conf , so mihawkos never got access to your files. the helper now keeps running and writes its log to a file instead. you no longer need to create or fix dev.conf the payload checklist tells you what s really wrong. when mihawkos cannot see your payloads because it has no access to data , the checklist no longer calls every payload missing . it says what is blocking it, and how to fix it played on the console standard ps5, firmware 13.60, with the payloads loaded through payload manager a dev.conf pointing at an address nobody answers the reported case : the access helper kept running mihawkos got data , and the payload checklist passed the full test battery of 104 cases: 102 passed, the other two skipped by a test-network setting alpha5-hotfix-base-2026-10-29-01 . the payload checklist passed at every one of its 143 starts installing or updating new install: the same as alpha 5: copy ppsa99170 to data homebrew , open mihawkos, and the guided setup installs the runtime from a usb drive or over ftp updating from alpha 5 or alpha 4 1. replace the ppsa99170 folder in data homebrew with the new one 2. put the new runtime pieces on your usb drive the mihawkos folder from the runtime zip , or have them ready for ftp 3. open mihawkos from its own icon. it sees that the runtime belongs to the previous build and offers to install the new one 4. restart the ps5 , load your payloads, and open mihawkos your prefix, your games in c: games , steam and your settings are kept ps5 mihawkos-v5.0.1-alpha-5-ppsa99170.zip size: 20.0 mb; 429374136.body: mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions resident evil 4 runs. installers are faster. the alpha 5 hotfix is built in the sixth alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own mihawk os. it is still experimental at a glance what s new resident evil 4 runs. directx 12 games that reserve graphics memory now start, instead of stopping with fatal d3d error e outofmemory installers are about 20 faster. directx and visual c setups start their many small programs more quickly the alpha 5 hotfix is included: no dev.conf needed, and a payload checklist that says what is really wrong in this release resident evil 4 and directx 12 faster installers from the hotfix played on the console known limits installing or updating source and credits resident evil 4 and directx 12 games reserved graphics memory now works in games. some directx 12 games, resident evil 4 among them, set aside a block of graphics memory and fill it in later. mihawkos s graphics layer could not do that inside a game, so the game stopped at once with fatal d3d error 6, e outofmemory , even with plenty of memory free. it now can resident evil 4 steam on a ps5 pro 10.01 : starts from steam s library and plays steadily at about 87-91 frames a second over five minutes, with the memory guard never acting games are told how much video memory the console can really give. resident evil 4 was offered 5.26 gib on a ps5 pro and no graphics allocation was refused faster installers installers start hundreds of small programs, and each one used to waste time looking for files that do not exist and decoding the desktop wallpaper it never shows. measured on a standard ps5 13.60 directx setup install alpha 5: 97.9 s; alpha 6: 78.3 s visual c redistributable install alpha 5: 12.0 s; alpha 6: 9.8 s visual c redistributable uninstall alpha 5: 9.9 s; alpha 6: 7.6 s from the 5.0.1 hotfix no dev.conf needed. mihawkos gets access to data even when data homebrew dev.conf is missing or points somewhere unreachable the payload checklist tells you what is really wrong. when mihawkos cannot see your payloads because it has no access to data , it says so instead of calling every payload missing played on the console this release s build was tested on a ps5 pro firmware 10.01 . the installer timings above were measured on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 with the same installer changes, and that build passed the full battery of 104 cases there ps5 pro, firmware 10.01, the full test battery of 104 cases: 102 passed, the other two skipped by a test-network setting alpha6-pro-2026-10-30-02 resident evil 4 on the ps5 pro: five minutes in game from steam s library at about 87-91 frames a second; no graphics allocation refused; the memory guard never acted resident evil 3 demo 5 minutes, about 123 frames a second and a 2d game 3 minutes, 61 frames a second unchanged from alpha 5; steam s browser paused during each game and came back after known limits steam big picture is a little less smooth than in alpha 4 on a standard ps5. alpha 4 ran steam s browser as several processes on firmware 12.00 and later; that used up the console s page tables and could crash it with a game open. it now runs as one process on every console: slower frames while scrolling went from 7 in alpha 4 to about 66 alpha 3 had 162 the kstuff version is shown but not checked. the ps5 does not let mihawkos ask kstuff its version; the checklist only sees that it is running. please use kstuff lite 1.11 beta or later restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts. mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens resident evil 4 has been tested on a ps5 pro only. measurements suggest it should also fit beside steam on a standard ps5, but that has not been run yet firmware 6.xx to 9.xx: no volunteer has measured these yet; they use the below 12.00 limits the ps5 pro has less memory for windows programs , warning at about 850 mib translations still need a native speaker s review. the mihawk 11 desktop stays in english the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode not supported: kernel drivers and anti-cheat, so many online games with anti-cheat will not run installing or updating ps5 mihawkos-v6.0.0-alpha-6-ppsa99170.zip size: 19.7 mb; what it is: the mihawkos
